description: Defines the BasicWorkSchedule class implementing work schedule logic for HRM system, including work shift times, non-working days, and holidays.

classes.name: BasicWorkSchedule
classes.description: Implements work schedule interface, managing employee work shifts, non-working days, and holidays.

methods.name: getWorkShiftService
methods.description: Returns the WorkShiftService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of the employee's work shift in hours.

methods.name: getWorkShiftStartEndTime
methods.description: Returns the start and end times of the employee's work shift.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a non-working day.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.
